summary: Enel Chile S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its consolidated financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The report details net income of US$272 million for the first half, a 10.7% increase year-over-year, and an EBITDA of US$685 million, up 3.9%. It also notes the start of construction of the Azabache BESS battery energy storage system on April 1, 2026. This is a routine earnings release with no M&A, restructuring, or special-event action; the filing is a standard foreign private issuer update under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned; no special situation is present.
